name: myslime-monorepo
description: A gamified productivity app. Users will stay productive with a virtual slime

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm run hooks:install
scripts.check:backend: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run test:ci
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check:release: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend

author: Ralph Jude Cruz
